title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Catch-Up Deposits and the Deposit Booking Tool
content:
**Cartwise Shopper Payouts — desk reference: catch-up deposits**

## Where this applies

A Cartwise Shopper Payouts account sweeps unpaid earnings to the payout destination on each weekly deposit day. Weekly deposit days can pass while the payout account is not active. For those days the company sends a single catch-up deposit once the account is active again, covering every earnings period those days would have swept. The catch-up deposit is sent from the unpaid earnings balance to the payout destination on file.

## Timing of the amount

A catch-up deposit is fixed only after the latest returned-transfer entry on the account has a re-send deposit pointing to it.

Put another way: while the latest returned-transfer entry on the account has no re-send deposit pointing to it, the amount of the catch-up deposit is not yet fixed.

## What the booking records

Once booked, the account carries a catch-up deposit covering the weekly deposit days that passed while the account was not active, labelled with the end of the latest closed weekly earnings period, and the unpaid earnings balance shown on the account falls by the amount deposited.

## The booking tool: `send_catchup_deposit_164755b4`

**Capability.** Sends a single catch-up deposit for weekly deposits that could not go out while the shopper payout account was not active. One call books one deposit on the account: the stated amount leaves the unpaid earnings balance and goes to the payout destination on file, labelled with the last day of the weekly earnings period it closes. The balance shown on the account falls by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `send_catchup_deposit_164755b4` and then calls it; the shopper does not run it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_account_id` | The shopper payout account number the deposit is booked on, read from the payout account lookup | Identifier |
| `payout_period_end` | The last day of the weekly earnings period the deposit closes | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount_usd` | The amount deposited | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); booked exactly as given with no further rounding |

**Return.** A successful call returns a receipt with: `status` ("deposited" when the deposit was booked); `payout_event_id` (the reference number of the new deposit entry); `payout_period_end` (the period end it carries, YYYY-MM-DD); `amount_usd` (the amount sent, USD with 2 decimal places); `event_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD); `available_balance_usd` (the unpaid earnings balance left on the account, USD with 2 decimal places).

## Points of judgement

- **One deposit or several?** One catch-up deposit covers every earnings period the missed weekly deposit days would have swept.
- **Which period end is labelled?** The end of the latest closed weekly earnings period.
- **What does the tool decide?** Nothing about the amount: the amount is passed in as worked out under the rules of Cartwise Shopper Payouts, and the tool books it exactly as given.
